name: Richard Corvera Hernandez
office: City of Cudahy, Member of the City Council

items.text: Richard Corvera Hernandez served on the Cudahy Planning Commission from January 2022 until April 21, 2026, when the City Council voted to remove and replace him. Mayor Alcantar appointed him to the commission.

sentences.text: Richard Corvera Hernandez served on the Cudahy Planning Commission from January 2022 until April 21, 2026, when the City Council voted to remove and replace him.
Mayor Alcantar appointed him to the commission.
